plain: Land under a government, such as a region that is not yet a state

webster.text: The extent or compass of land within the bounds or belonging to the jurisdiction of any state, city or other body.

example.quote: The Congress shall have Power to dispose of and make all needful Rules and Regulations respecting the Territory or other Property belonging to the United States; and nothing in this Constitution shall be so construed as to Prejudice any Claims of the United States, or of any particular State.
